EC1: Non-compliance [AND] with DOTPlus. Alternatively DOT can be done by telephoning patient on a daily basis 5 times a week and having patient annotate taking drug in a log which would be reviewed by clinic staff
EC2: History of being treated [OR] for tuberculosis in the prior 2 years unless there is DST, [AND] including PCR testing , showing sensitivity [AND] to rifamycin.
EC3: Known hypersensitivity to rifampin [OR] or rifabutin.
EC4: Liver enzymes greater than 2 times ULN.
EC6: Serum creatinine greater than 3 times ULN.
EC7: Hemoglobin less than 7.0 gms even if receiving erythropoietin.
EC8: Absolute neutrophil count less than 750 cells/mm3 even if receiving G-CSF.
EC10: Fasting cholesterol > 1.6 upper limits of normal.
EC11: GI intolerance [AND] of tuberculosis medications requiring discontinuation [AND] of tuberculosis medications.
EC14: Use of one of the prohibited medications
EC15: Any condition that the investigators feel could compromise the use of the current medication.
EC16: Have a CD4 cell count of 50 cells/mm3or less
EC18: Alcohol [OR] or illicit drug use, which in the investigators opinion may affect participation in study.
